editorial.name: Typeform
editorial.descriptionZh: 表单与问卷搭建 SaaS 的产品首页，主打用一句 prompt 出表单，再把回答结果接到 Growth Flow 里做线索富化与自动跟进。
editorial.takeawayZh: 一句 prompt 出表单，答案直接进自动化流
editorial.noteZh: 这一版首屏只渲染到顶栏和一条紫色公告条，公告写 Research, but without the wait: join our Research Flow webinar on Sept 16 / Register now，导航是 Platform / Solutions / Resources / Pricing，把正文挤到了折叠线以下。从渲染后的 DOM 看：标题 Your favorite forms. Now with AI automation.，三段能力是 High Response Rate、Deeper Insights、Advanced Analytics，数字写 over 48 million responses collected monthly 与 3.5x more data；再往下是 GROWTH FLOW 段落讲 enrich leads、create segments、send personalized messages；研究侧单列 Run fast research, moderated by AI 与 Verified Panel Recruitment、Qualitative & Quantitative。
editorial.pricing: Freemium（首页写 Start free，站内有 /pricing 与 /enterprise，首页未列价格）

reasons.statement: 站点自己的标题是 Form Builder with AI Automation，交付物是搭出来的表单/问卷/测验（/forms、/surveys、/quizzes、/test-maker、/nps-form-builder 等路径），归设计与内容创作工具。
说明：分类置信度中等——站内研究侧（Run fast research, moderated by AI、Verified Panel Recruitment、内容含 Qualitative & Quantitative）与候选目录 toools.design 的 best-ux-tools 定位都指向研究与测试工具，本次取站点自述的表单搭建一侧。
